recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
echo -e "keyAlias=keyAlias\nkeyPassword=keyPassword\nstorePassword=storePassword\nstoreFile=/dev/null" > key.properties
touch local.properties
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
submodules/flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
submodules/flutter/bin/flutter pub get
submodules/flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform android-arm64 --flavor fdroid
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/apk/fdroid/release/app-fdroid-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
